description: Signal connections in a scene file. A connect to a method the target lacks, or one that cannot take what the signal passes, is written, with methodFound or argumentsFit false. A missing method is refused with binds or unbinds. A write puts back each connection the engine dropped on load, under unmadeConnections. Headless, it updates .godot's class list and starts autoloads. Operations: connect (needs sourceNodePath, signalName, targetNodePath, methodName); disconnect (needs sourceNodePath, signalName, targetNodePath, methodName); list: every connection in the scene.

binds.description: The values passed after the signal's own. [] removes the connection's binds. Default: those it has. For op connect.

flags.description: Object.ConnectFlags added together: deferred 1, persist 2, one_shot 4, reference_counted 8, append_source_object 16. For op connect.

methodName.description: The method on that node, called when it emits. Not for op list.

nodePath.description: Only connections involving this node. For op list.

signalName.description: The signal it emits, such as "pressed". Not for op list.

sourceNodePath.description: The node that emits. Not for op list.

targetNodePath.description: The node whose method is called. Not for op list.

unbinds.description: How many of the signal's own arguments are dropped from the end. 0 removes the connection's unbinds. Default: what it has. For op connect.

name: scene_signal
title: Scene signals
